text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent on every pull request before human review. It catches 80% of trivia like typos, formatting, and missing docs, freeing humans for real decisions. The trade-off is setup time—configuring PR-Agent and training the team—but the net gain is faster, cleaner merges.

name: Gauge
text: PR-Agent’s false positives aren’t the only risk—it also misses context-dependent issues like architectural drift or security gaps, where 20% of the misses matter more than the 80% trivia it catches. A better alternative is to use PR-Agent as a *filter*, not a gatekeeper: run it post-review to clean up trivia, but keep humans in the loop for decisions where context and trade-offs matter. Settle it by measuring how often PR-Agent’s misses force reverts or post-merge fixes in the next two sprints.

name: Sprocket
text:
Run PR-Agent as a *gatekeeper* on every pull request before human review. The 80% trivia it catches—typos, formatting, missing docs—saves human time for real decisions. The trade-off is accepting its 20% false positives and misses, but the net gain is faster, cleaner merges with fewer trivial distractions.

name: Gauge
text: PR-Agent as a gatekeeper risks normalizing mediocre reviews—teams will rubber-stamp its 20% misses because the "bot already checked," turning architectural drift and security gaps into ticking time bombs. A better alternative is to run it *post-review* as a cleanup tool, where humans still own the call, and PR-Agent’s false positives are just noise to ignore, not decisions to accept. Settle it by running a 30-day pilot: compare merge speed and post-merge incident rates between gatekeeper and post-review modes.

name: Ratchet
text:
DECISION: Run PR-Agent as a lightweight pre-filter *after* human triage, not before—catching 80% trivia without gatekeeping, while humans still own context-heavy decisions.

Result: PR-Agent flags mechanical issues post-triage; humans review architecture/security; cleaner merges without false confidence. Owner: Lead.
